screen.basis: Native optical face plus0.008 mm presentation offset; exact face indices and viewing/emissive distinction recorded in dimensions.

inspectionGroups.notes: Debug separation of entire native optical components, including flex; no implied operating distance.

dimensionTargets.scope: Published nominal dimensions versus unscaled original topology.

sourceSearch.result: Exact product native STEP found in the complete pinned official tree. Every selected topology retains original millimetre coordinates; omitted indices are enumerated per SKU.

materialBasis: Native OCCT linear RGB converted to sRGB where present. Uncoloured optical component0 uses source-photo black; remaining uncoloured topology uses neutral grey, without pretending the source supplied a material.
assemblyNotes: Native source coordinates preserved exactly; front is +Z. Optical flex tails keep their real source poses. Debug separation is not assembly spacing.
limitations: Native CAD is a manufacturer mechanical export, not an electrical schematic or production-revision guarantee.
No hardware-fit or browser WebGL acceptance claim. Unspecified CAD material uses a stated fallback, never a fabricated silkscreen or texture.
Live framebuffer is projected onto the native front viewing face; this rendering offset is not glass thickness.

Published resolution172×320 conflicts with pinned BSP180×320 plus30-column gap. Runtime exposes the advertised172-pixel physical centre crop with34-column gap; side4 pixels from each BSP edge are outside the declared visible screen.
The photographed rear view is rotated180 degrees relative to the native USB-down front convention; native negative-X side switch is BOOT9.

The official STEP is the bare-board assembly. SKU34664-M adds source-positioned schematic header geometry; exact header body, section, length and plating remain UNKNOWN estimates. This subset is not manufacturer CAD for the added pins.

source.stp.gz.grouping: Every retained native topology is independently represented. No scaling, invented fillet or source-coordinate flattening.
